Title: Public Preview: Visual Studio Application Insights

Body.Content: Development teams can gain insights into the performance, availability, and usage of their server, web, and mobile applications by using Visual Studio Application Insights, which is now available for public preview. For more information, please visit the Application Insights page. For pricing information, please visit the Visual Studio Application Insights Pricing page.
Body.Markdown:
Development teams can gain insights into the performance, availability, and usage of their server, web, and mobile applications by using Visual Studio Application Insights, which is now available for public preview.

For more information, please visit the Application Insights page. For pricing information, please visit the Visual Studio Application Insights Pricing page.
